title: Veo 3 for Developers — Paige Bailey, Google DeepMind
talk_summary: A Google DeepMind product talk demoing Veo 3, Imagen 4, and Lyria 2 generative media models, their creative controls (reference images, camera control, inpainting/outpainting, first/last-frame interpolation), and API access.

takeaways.technique: LLM-planned task decomposition into model-sized chunks
takeaways.what_they_do: To replicate a 30s commercial with a model capped at 8-second outputs, they had Gemini produce a detailed plan, segment it into per-clip prompts, generate each clip, then stitch with transitions in an editor.
takeaways.evidence_quote: give Gemini the original video, have it create a really really detailed plan. Um, segment into prompts to like handle the 8-second limitation

takeaways.technique: Route by capability tier, not one model for everything
takeaways.what_they_do: They expose the same task across multiple model tiers/access paths (Ultra/Pro plans, Vertex private preview, API) and note switching models is a few lines of code.
takeaways.evidence_quote: toggling between different models or being able to specify some of these is just a handful of lines of code
